user.title: Log in to Albert Heijn
user.description:
1. Open [the AH login page]({login_url}) in a desktop browser with developer tools open (F12, Network tab, 'Preserve log' on).
2. Log in. The browser cannot open the result, but the Network tab shows a redirect to `appie://login-exit?code=…`.
3. Paste that whole line, or just the value after `code=`, below. The code is short-lived and works once.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your Albert Heijn login has expired. Repeat the steps with [the AH login page]({login_url}) and paste the code.

error.invalid_code: Code rejected (expired or already used). Log in again for a new code.

abort.wrong_account: This is a different AH account than the one configured.

add_regulars.name: Add regular products to shopping list

save_recipe.name: Save recipe
save_recipe.description: Saves (or updates) a recipe. Each recipe gets a persons field and a button.

persons.name: Persons
persons.description: Number of persons the amounts are for

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: One per line, e.g. '400 g mince'. You can paste a recipe from the web.

delete_recipe.name: Delete recipe
delete_recipe.description: Deletes a recipe and its entities.

add_recipe_to_list.name: Recipe to shopping list
add_recipe_to_list.description: Puts the recipe (scaled to persons) on the AH shopping list.
